about.what: Which robot hangs in which slot of the frame, as of October 2026 (decided 2026-10-02: arms are named by slot; the old prime-number robot ids live on only here). Read by the robot side (robot/), never by the planning code: aris/rig.py does not read site/.
about.slots_note: slot = row 1..3 along table y (-1.21, 0, +1.21 m; row 3 at Diemut's desk) and L/R AS SEEN FROM HER DESK: L = her left = table x = +0.305, R = her right = -0.305 (renamed 2026-10-08); see config/rig.json slots.
about.mapping_source: Diemut's map, 2026-10-08, in her L/R: back row 1L = robot 31 (.12), 1R = 2 (.13); middle 2L = 71 (.14), 2R = 97 (.15); front row (her desk) 3L = 13 (.11), 3R = 17 (.16), all six hanging inverted. Earlier tables (2026-10-02/05/06) are superseded.
about.ip_source: robot/site.json `arms` (control-stack briefing 2026-09-09, section 5, arm_registry.py), carried over by robot id. The DDS domain there was the robot id; it is copied as `domain`.
about.live_note: the arms under control are the middle row, 2L (robot 97) and 2R (robot 71), config/two_arms. 1L and 1R hang in their slots switched off and are fenced off; 3L is a floor-mounted upright arm and 3R is empty (no hanger steel at either, config/rig.json slots `hanger: false`).
about.sure_note: `sure: true` rows were checked on site on 2026-10-06. `controlled: "never"` marks a robot this rig must never drive; `absent: true` a slot with no robot in it (the robot named is kept, with its address, so that the table stays complete).
about.orientation: Corrected 2026-10-06: the frame is the axes sheet turned 180 degrees. The J1 axis is offset 25.15 mm toward table +x of its plate centre (config/rig.json hanger.turned_note). Diemut's desk side and the L/R reading of 2026-10-05 (docs/figures/table_orientation.png) were made with the unturned sheet: re-check them against the drawn crosses.
